about.title: About
about.description:
I'm a full-stack developer with 3+ years of experience building web and mobile applications. I focus on turning ideas into real, usable products — not just writing code.
I’ve worked across frontend, backend, and mobile, using technologies like Vue, NestJS, and native mobile frameworks. I enjoy building systems that are clean, scalable, and easy to maintain.
In the AI era, I believe the value of a developer is not just technical skill, but the ability to understand problems, make decisions, and ship meaningful products.
